title: アオハル杯4戦目・あともう一歩

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: This must be all my fault… Maybe the team's better off without me…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No, that's not right… Everyone said they need me, and I believe them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to work harder and do my best for all of them!
